Frequently asked questions

Answers before you start.

Quick guidance on trials, activation, devices, buffering and renewals.

Can I request a free trial?

Ask support whether a trial is currently available. Tell them which device and player you use.

Which devices are supported?

Compatible IPTV players are available for many Smart TVs, Fire TV devices, Android devices, iPhones, iPads, Windows PCs and Macs. Confirm your exact model before ordering.

How many connections come with a plan?

Connection limits depend on the current package. Ask support to confirm simultaneous streams before ordering.

How is my subscription activated?

After your order is confirmed, support provides the access details and the setup method for your compatible player.

Why is a stream buffering?

Check your internet connection, restart the player and router, then try another stream. Contact support with your device and player details if it continues.

Can I renew my subscription?

Contact support before expiry with your existing account details and the term you want.

Do I need a specific player?

The correct player depends on your device and the access method supplied with your account. Ask support before installing an app.

Can I use IPTV while travelling?

Access can depend on your location, connection and current plan terms. Ask support about your specific situation.

What should I send support for setup help?

Share your device model, player name, the issue you see and any error message. Do not post your password publicly.

Are prices shown in US dollars?

Yes. Website plan prices are in USD. One connection starts at $15 for 1 month; multi-connection discounts apply to the combined base price.
